call.statement: Example domains are reserved for use in documentation.
call.criteria: Support requires the page itself to state or demonstrate the documentation purpose of the domain. Mere mention is NEUTRAL.

notes: All source_ids must already be registered; they are sorted and deduplicated before the definition is fingerprinted.
required_support_groups must be between 1 and the number of distinct sources.
source_ids may contain at most 8 identifiers (28 pairwise relations at assessment time).
